definition: Descriptive is True on factual atoms, False on forbidden-action atoms, and the conjunction of the recursive tests on conditional antecedent and consequent. Thus no forbidden-action occurrence appears at any depth. It excludes normative bridges syntactically, rather than establishing a natural-language fact/value classification.
note: This is an analyst restriction of the existing Sentence grammar, reused without changing its constructors or support clauses. Actual moral/naturalistic analyses may dispute that classification; no attribution to Hume or Carneades is made.
